name: Wrentham Village Premium Outlets
summary: Wrentham Village Premium Outlets is a premier outlet shopping destination in Massachusetts, offering designer and name-brand stores at discounted prices in an open-air village setting. Located conveniently between Boston and Providence, the center attracts shoppers from throughout New England seeking savings of 25-65% on premium brands.
demographics: Wrentham Village Premium Outlets attracts a diverse mix of value-conscious shoppers from the greater Boston metropolitan area and beyond, including families and tourists seeking designer brands at discounted prices. The trade area draws heavily from affluent suburban communities in Massachusetts and Rhode Island, with visitors typically ranging from middle to upper-middle income households who appreciate premium brands at outlet pricing. The center sees significant weekend and holiday traffic from both local residents within a 30-mile radius and destination shoppers traveling from Boston, Providence, and even international tourists, creating a dynamic mix of regular customers and occasional visitors seeking deals on high-quality merchandise.
description: Wrentham Village Premium Outlets stands as one of New England's premier outlet shopping destinations, located conveniently at 1 Premium Outlet Blvd in Wrentham, Massachusetts. As part of the renowned Premium Outlets collection, this open-air shopping center offers an exceptional retail experience featuring a curated selection of designer and name-brand outlet stores offering savings of 25% to 65% every day. The center's strategic location just off Interstate 495, approximately 35 miles southwest of Boston and 20 miles north of Providence, makes it easily accessible to millions of shoppers throughout the region. With its village-style layout and pedestrian-friendly design, visitors can enjoy a comfortable shopping experience while exploring a diverse mix of fashion, accessories, footwear, and lifestyle brands. The center has earned an impressive 4.5-star rating from over 14,000 reviews, reflecting its popularity and the quality shopping experience it provides to both local residents and tourists seeking premium brands at outlet prices.
